transcript.text: I need to raise an engineering constraint before Riley approves the flag. While debugging an unrelated queue-consumer issue this morning, I measured that more than 2 concurrent inference requests can exhaust the triage worker's connection pool. When that happens, timeouts bypass the intended manual-review fallback and leave tickets without a routing label. I have not filed this finding in the launch ticket yet. The fix is straightforward: capping concurrency at 2 in the rollout configuration is sufficient to satisfy this engineering constraint, and no separate engineering deployment is required before flag enablement. This concurrency cap needs to be included in the rollout configuration before the flag is approved.
